notes.title: ⚔️ Prepare to board! Flint: Treasure of Oblivion is now available 🏴‍☠️
notes.content:
Ahoy there!

This is it, mateys! Set sail for the perilous treasure hunt of [i]Flint: Treasure of Oblivion[/i], [b]now available[/b]!

[previewyoutube=IzWAC2GR6mw;full][/previewyoutube]

♟️ [b]Turn-Based Tactical Combat[/b] - A good preparation is key: Choose your crew members with unique abilities, obtain new skills, improve your dice. During the tactical phases, use cards to trigger skills and attributes, and influence the fight with dice throws.

🗯️ [b]Comic-Book Narrative[/b] - Enjoy a story that, beyond the usual comic tropes (onomatopoeia, speech bubbles), offers the player original and dynamic comic book panels.

🧭 [b]An Exploration Beyond the Oceans[/b] - Discover a magnificent world, from the French city of Saint-Malo to the exotic landscapes of central America. Visit diverse environments (cities, camps, jungle, caves…) using the power of the Unreal Engine 5.

🏴‍☠️ [b]Historically-Inspired Piracy World[/b] - The game faithfully recreates a world of piracy, incorporating historical elements (language, costumes, weapons) making the experience even more immersive.

[h2]Don’t pass on the Digital Deluxe Edition’s loot[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44962209/6556097536342fea4255f170964e06584f735fd4.png[/img]

It includes:
[list][*]The game [i]Flint: Treasure of Oblivion[/i]
[*]The Digital Artbook
[*]The Original Soundtrack
[*]5 Dioramas
[*]5 Character Sheets
[*]A 3D Print File for a figurine of James Flint[/list]

[previewyoutube=sG4AIQ-zGtg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]For Glory & Salvation![/h2]

We’ve partnered with our friends at [b]Nacon[/b] to bring you the exclusive [b]Knights & Pirates Bundle[/b]! Save 10% on both games!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48359/Knights__Pirates/

🏴‍☠️ [b]Play Flint: Treasure of Oblivion now[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2366130

📬 [b]Stay connected![/b]
